name: New Beginnings
overview: Scripture reveals that new beginnings are rooted in God's sovereign creative power, as seen in Genesis 1:1 where God initiates all things. Though beginnings may seem small or humble, like Job 8:7 states, God promises growth and increase in the latter end. Believers are encouraged to look beyond past failures and former things (Isaiah 43:18), trusting in the Lord to renew their strength and enable them to rise and persevere (Isaiah 40:31). Obedience to God's commands leads to exaltation and blessing, highlighting that new beginnings come through faithful dependence on Him (Deuteronomy 28:1).
